title: Prove arbitrary-term asymmetric cost20 on 18 physical C5 cores
body:
## Summary

```text
PR3256: arbitrary-term asymmetric cost20 on 1 physical C5
This proof: cost20 on 18 physical C5s, including 17 additional cores
Remaining: 5 named cores stay open
```

The theorem covers ordinary-transpose strict-scalar fits over Q, R or C with arbitrary finite asymmetric terms and the inherited complete-plane binary pairing tariff. It checks each actual rectangular tariff table and a valid physical orientation. Five exact terms attain20 on every covered core. Certificate failure on the other five is not a cheaper decoder.

The self-contained proof and two implementations are in `research/c5-asymmetric-physical-cores/`. Geometry comes from two authenticated canonical-main inputs; fresh CI and direct exports need no pending fork object or executable. Credit thakrarsagar/PR3256 at `1ea98246dabb46fc7bedf6127eff63f008414a39`, Tekalign/PR2782, Arham Tahir/PR2879, Sagar Thakrar/PR2484, Cinna Davis/PR1825, Adam Gall/PR1889, Nick Petalas/PR3248, ctoth, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained E8/P112 geometry lineage.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3256 leaves the other22 physical tariff tables open. **After:** actual tables certify17 additional cores; all198 cost18/19 cases are excluded and all18 complete cost20 fits pass.
- Registered CPython3.12.15 replay passes primary, separate reconstruction and six optimized behavioral groups. The second implementation enumerates all3,819,816 five-subsets, uses dense binary rank, rational trace elimination and cost-layer reachability, and agrees on54,014 visited states. Ruff diagnostics, formatting and warnings-as-errors compilation pass.
- A read-only Git-free export containing only the package and its two declared inputs passes all three direct scripts under optimized CPython3.13.16. Worker2's scoped read-only peer check found no blocking issue, matched all10frozen hashes and both canonical inputs, and independently passed all three scripts. REVIEW.json records exact bytes and unrun limits. All13committed package/input bytes and archive integrity pass at ee5d4f466e6e44a1897896324a36aa4c64cf3912;the actual committed read-only Git-free export passes all three scripts on optimizedPython3.13.16.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/c5-asymmetric-physical-cores
```

Scientific baseline is canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision6. [Canonical investigation, exact residuals and scope correction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19003538). Open next questions and unrun obligations are explicit. There is no all23-core/global decoder floor, native implementation, dirty restoration, hosting/precision bill, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or proof-kernel review was run.

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in research package. Frozen sources, shared checkers and selected records are unchanged. Archival retention does not establish supplier admission.
